Caveat: a global before_request outside this file could enforce login, but that would still not add an object-level check. Confirm whether this is intended as admin-only.

verdict.guard_found: none. The route at invoices.py:7 has no auth decorator, and get_invoice (line 8) does a raw INVOICES.get(inv_id) with no ownership comparison, then returns the full record via jsonify (line 10). verdict.reason: Anonymous callers can reach get_invoice at invoices.py:8-10 with an arbitrary inv_id and receive any invoice, since no auth or ownership check sits between the path parameter and jsonify(inv) at line 10, unlike /my/invoice at line 16. Whether this is intended as admin-only cannot be determined from the code, but the sibling /my/ routes suggest per-customer scoping was meant to apply.
